timing_scope: 50-MHz core checked. External asynchronous slow probe pins to input synchronizers excepted. Analog levels, 100-kHz I2C and TMDS are not proven by this probe.
connection: Disconnect PC and monitor. Connect the same secondary board's HDMIA to HDMIB with one ordinary HDMI cable. No adapters, injected voltages or enclosure removal.
operation: Load through JTAG only. Eight 0.5-second static-level tests; KEY1 restarts. Final F0FF is digital path pass, not PC/video/audio pass.
phase_bits: SCL released high at A and B
SCL A-to-B low at A and B
SDA released high at A and B
SDA A-to-B low at A and B
SDA B-to-A low at A and B
all DDC released high and HPD high
failed_probe_boundary: A failed bit identifies a signal path, not a specific bad connector/chip. The loop includes both ports, both translator channels, cable and receiver GPIO.
